banner.simulated: Simulated data. Every person, message and case shown here is synthetic. No text message or email is really sent.

errors.unreachable: The simulator could not be reached.
errors.notJson: The simulator's answer was not understood.

inbox.title: Inboxes
inbox.description: Every text message and email CareLoop sent, shown the way a basic phone and a mailbox show them. CareLoop reaches patients, caregivers and staff by text message and email only. A delivered message is not an acknowledgement: only the patient's own reply is.
inbox.empty: No messages in this inbox yet. A message appears here when CareLoop sends one.
inbox.notAnswerable: This message did not reach the patient, so the patient cannot reply to it.

readOnly.Caregiver: A caregiver's message. Only the patient replies to the clinic, so there is nothing here to answer and nothing the caregiver does is reported as the patient's.
readOnly.Staff: A staff notice. It carries no patient detail, and nobody replies to it here: staff act on the case in CareLoop.

sms.caption: A text message on a basic phone with no internet. Reply 1 to confirm you got the message, or 2 to ask for a call. The reply is sent to CareLoop as typed; CareLoop reads any other reply as a request for a call.

email.subject: Subject
email.caption: An email with no links. Reply 1 to confirm you got the message, or 2 to ask for a call. The reply is sent to CareLoop as typed; CareLoop reads any other reply as a request for a call.

records.heading: What CareLoop is told

deliveryDetail.Pending: CareLoop has not accepted a delivery report for this message.
deliveryDetail.Delivered: A delivery report was sent. Delivery is not an acknowledgement.
deliveryDetail.Silent: The channel stayed silent, so CareLoop's own deadline has to notice.

records.noReplyDetail: The patient has not replied, so the message is not acknowledged.

meaning.WillCome: CareLoop reads 1 as: the patient got the message. This is the acknowledgement.
meaning.CallMe: CareLoop reads 2 as: the patient asks for a call. This is not an acknowledgement.
meaning.Other: CareLoop reads any other reply as a request for a call. This is not an acknowledgement.

records.byNurseDetail: Not recorded here. A nurse records them in CareLoop after a call.

onlyPatientDetail.Caregiver: Nothing a caregiver does is recorded as the patient's.
onlyPatientDetail.Staff: A staff notice is not part of the patient's record of being notified.

patientBehaviours.title: Patient behaviours
patientBehaviours.description: Choose how each simulated patient reacts when CareLoop sends them a text message or an email. A patient only reacts to a message that arrives, and delivery is never an acknowledgement.
patientBehaviours.defaultDescription: Used for every patient that has no behaviour of their own.
patientBehaviours.listEmpty: No patient has a behaviour of their own. Every patient gets the default.
patientBehaviours.patientIdHint: Must be synthetic: it starts with SYN-. It is also the address the patient's messages are sent to.

validation.patientId: The patient identifier must start with SYN-.
validation.failureReason: A delivery that fails needs a reason.
validation.respondAfter: The delay must be zero or more seconds.
validation.respondToNotification: The notification number must be 1 or more.

patientBehaviours.responseNeedsDelivery: A patient can only respond to a delivered notification.

scenarioRunner.title: Scenario runner
scenarioRunner.description: Put the patient behaviours of a shared scenario in force, then watch how those patients react to CareLoop's notifications. A run sends nothing by itself.
scenarioRunner.cohort: A cohort cannot be run here. Run the scenarios it draws from.
scenarioRunner.unusable: This scenario file cannot be used: {{problem}}

status.Running: Running: waiting for and reacting to notifications
status.Failed: Failed: a reaction was refused or could not be sent

scenarioRunner.noReactions: Nothing has happened yet. No notification has arrived for these patients.

messageLog.title: Message log
messageLog.description: Every exchange between this simulator and CareLoop, newest first: the text messages and emails CareLoop sent, and the delivery reports and replies sent back.
messageLog.selectHint: Select an exchange to see its JSON.
